name: VRF System Service
tagline: Multi-brand VRF care for Chennai buildings
headline: Every VRF Brand, Serviced to Its Design Capacity
summary: One outdoor unit, dozens of indoor units, and an entire building depending on both. Airam services LG Multi V, Mitsubishi Electric City Multi, Toshiba and Samsung DVM systems across Chennai — per-IDU cleaning, ODU health audits and capacity balancing that keeps every zone at its design temperature. Site-visit quotes in writing, GST invoices, up to 90-day warranty on repairs.

symptoms.title: Uneven cooling between zones
symptoms.description: Cabins on one floor freeze while the far wing sits at 30°C — a sign refrigerant distribution has drifted from design and needs rebalancing.

symptoms.title: ODU tripping at peak heat
symptoms.description: Outdoor modules cutting out during 40°C afternoons usually mean a choked condenser coil or a compressor stage working beyond its limits.

symptoms.title: Error codes on multiple IDUs
symptoms.description: Several indoor units flashing faults at once points to a communication bus or refrigerant circuit problem, not one failed unit.

symptoms.title: Electricity bills creeping up
symptoms.description: A VRF running out of balance draws more power every month as compressors overwork to cover starved zones.

symptoms.title: Corrosion on coastal ODUs
symptoms.description: Sea air near the coast eats condenser fins first — white or green deposits on the coil mean treatment is overdue.

symptoms.title: Water stains under ceilings
symptoms.description: Blocked condensate drains in cassette and ductable IDUs stain false ceilings before they short anything, and monsoon damp accelerates both.

benefits.title: Fluent in four VRF platforms
benefits.description: LG Multi V, Mitsubishi Electric City Multi, Toshiba and Samsung DVM each run their own controls, fault logic and service procedures. Our technicians work across all of them, so a mixed-brand building needs one vendor, not four.

benefits.title: Capacity balancing, not just cleaning
benefits.description: We measure what each zone actually receives against what the system was designed to deliver, then correct settings, valves or piping until the numbers match. Clean coils alone never fix a starved wing.

benefits.title: Built on service-floor experience
benefits.description: Our founder spent years on service calls in his father's AC business before starting Airam. That discipline shows in how VRF jobs are documented — readings logged, quotes in writing, nothing verbal.

benefits.title: Chennai-proofed maintenance
benefits.description: Coastal salt air corrodes ODU coils and voltage fluctuations stress inverter boards, so we check for both on every visit. Anti-corrosive treatment is recommended where the audit shows fin damage, not by default.

process.title: Book a site visit
process.description: Tell us the brand, IDU count and floor layout, and we schedule an engineer — same-day slots when available.

process.title: Audit every unit
process.description: We inspect each IDU and ODU, log refrigerant readings and error histories, and map cooling delivery zone by zone.

process.title: Quote, then work
process.description: You get a written, itemised quote; on approval we service, repair and rebalance with per-unit sign-off.

process.title: Report and warranty
process.description: You receive a system health report, a digital GST invoice and up to 90 days of warranty on repair work.

faqs.question: Which VRF brands do you service?
faqs.answer: Our core platforms are LG Multi V, Mitsubishi Electric City Multi, Toshiba and Samsung DVM, and we handle other major VRF systems as well. For Daikin VRV, see our dedicated VRV service page. Mixed-brand buildings get one team and one invoice.

faqs.question: How is this different from your VRV service?
faqs.answer: VRV is Daikin's trademark for the technology; every other manufacturer calls it VRF. The engineering principle is the same, but parts, controls and fault codes differ sharply by brand. We keep the pages separate so each system gets brand-specific procedures, not generic ones.

faqs.question: What does a capacity-balance check involve?
faqs.answer: We log temperature drop and airflow at every IDU and compare each zone against its design capacity, then read refrigerant distribution at the ODU. The result is a zone-by-zone report showing which areas are starved and why. Corrections range from control settings to valve and piping work, each quoted before we touch it.

faqs.question: Why site-visit quotes instead of fixed prices?
faqs.answer: No two VRF jobs match — a 6-IDU showroom and a 40-IDU office differ in hours, access and materials. We inspect first and give a written, GST-billed quote before any work begins. Per-IDU and per-ODU service rates are published above so you can estimate the routine portion yourself.

faqs.question: Can you service the system without shutting the whole building down?
faqs.answer: Largely, yes. IDUs are serviced zone by zone while the rest of the system keeps running, so most floors never notice. ODU deep service and refrigerant work need a planned shutdown window, which we schedule around your working hours.
